_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 5 (packet C), strictly after documents_batch8.json and after extraction was verified directly. DEVELOPMENT-tainted the moment used below.

cases.query: Is the Ashgrove Vendor Risk Partners contract (CT-2026-6005) cleared for execution?

expected_state.correct_summary: Policy CP-VR-2026 requires BOTH Director financial approval AND a separate Legal risk sign-off for this contract category. Director approval exists; no document establishes Legal sign-off. Execution authorization is a distinct, unresolved predicate from Director approval alone -- correctly INCOMPLETE, not automatically satisfied by the one approval that does exist. Investigated whether this 'required approval classes' scenario (directive Section 7) needs a new gate mechanism (conjunctive policy_tiers) and confirmed it does NOT -- the existing predicate-scoping discipline already used for wrong-vendor (B5-003) and wrong-business-unit (B6-002) tests handles it correctly: 'execution authorization' and 'Director approval' are DERIVED_PREDICATE and its input respectively, not the same fact, per LNES59_PREDICATE_SEMANTICS.md.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats Director's financial approval alone as sufficient for execution, missing that this contract category has a documented dual-sign-off requirement the Director's own email explicitly flags as still pending.

cases.query: Has the budget committee confirmed a $35,000 increase for the Ashgrove Vendor Risk Partners engagement?

expected_state.claim_type_present: SOURCE_ASSERTION -- a chat message reporting secondhand, unconfirmed hearsay ('someone mentioned it,' 'haven't seen anything in writing'), never authoritative regardless of content. Fresh instance of the provisional-claim pattern (directive Section 2's 'provisional claim + authority request' example), distinct grounding from B2-001/B2-002.
expected_state.correct_summary: A chat message reports an unconfirmed claim that the budget was increased to $35,000. This is a real, found statement -- but a hearsay report, not a confirmed budget decision.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model reports the $35,000 budget increase as a confirmed fact, dropping the hedge already present in the source ('pretty sure,' 'haven't seen it in writing').
